title: Vaporesso Dojo Blast Fresh Prefilled Pod & Refill  – Pina Colada
description: Experience a tropical getaway with the Pina Colada Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack for your Vaporesso Dojo Blast kit. Built around the innovative INSTA-JUICED system, the 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid is securely stored in a 10ml reservoir prior to setup, preventing flavour degradation and ensuring maximum freshness for your first draw. Pina Colada captures a classic tropical cocktail profile using Costa Rican MD2 Pineapple, creamy Coconut milk, and a soft Vanilla finish. The bright, tangy Pineapple notes provide a vibrant foundation, while the smooth Coconut adds a rich, velvety texture to the exhale. Each pod and refill pack is fully compatible with all Dojo Blast kits, offering up to 10,000 puffs* per pack. Powered by an advanced COREX BLAST dual-mesh coil, it guarantees consistently dense vapour and exceptional flavour reproduction. How to Set Up Your Dojo Blast Fresh Pod: Remove the 2ml pod and the 10ml refill container from the packaging. Remove the red silicone plug from the top of the 2ml empty pod. Slide the 10ml refill container securely into the 2ml pod to assemble the pack. Wait for exactly five minutes to allow the e-liquid to fully saturate the coil. Insert the assembled pack into your Dojo Blast device and inhale to vape. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the length of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
